newsitem.title: ITALY: TENNIS-CAMPORESE, FURLAN GIVE ITALY 2-0 LEAD.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-CAMPORESE, FURLAN GIVE ITALY 2-0 LEAD.

text.p: Veteran Omar Camporese and Italian number one Renzo Furlan scored easy victories on Friday to give Italy a 2-0 lead over Mexico after the first day's singles matches in their Davis Cup first round tie.
Camporese, 29, returning to the Davis Cup after a four-year absence, posted a comfortable 2-6 6-0 6-4 7-5 win over Mexican number one Alajandro Hernandez on clay at the Foro Italico.
The Italian scored 13 aces while Hernandez, a clay court specialist, had 16 double faults and several unforced errors.
Furlan, ranked 51 in the world, then had equally few problems dismissing Luis Herrera 3-6 6-1 6-2 6-1 on a beautiful spring-like day in Rome.
"We have done the maximum but we have not won the match," Furlan warned afterwards.
"We must be very careful and we have to remember that against France last year we lost 3-2 after winningthe first two matches."
Italy lost to France 3-2 in Nantes in the semifinals of the Davis Cup last year. Saturday's doubles match pits Diego Nargiso and Stefano Pescosolido against Mexico's Leonardo Lavalle and Oscar Ortiz.
